items.snippet: “Blue Planet III,” the latest installment of the BBC’s iconic series, “is better in just about every way,” New Scientist wrote.

items.headline: Ice hockey officials considering options after CAS order to reinstate Russia
items.snippet: Ice hockey's ruling body is deciding how to respond to a decision by the Court of Arbitration for Sport that allows Russia back into international competition. Germany hasn't ruled out pulling out as a tournament host.
